title: Retencija, auditabilnost i AI/ML podaci
summary: Politike retencije, brisanje (NIST SP 800-88, crypto-shredding), arhiviranje i legal hold; izvori i atributi događaja, logovanje, chain of custody i non-repudiation; privatnost i sigurnost AI/ML skupova podataka i modela.
summary_en: Retention policies, deletion (NIST SP 800-88, crypto-shredding), archiving and legal hold; event sources and attributes, logging, chain of custody, and non-repudiation; privacy and security of AI/ML datasets and models.
